Featuring Mark Gochnour, Head of Global Client Services Group   |   Jake DeKinder, Head of Client Communications   |   Wes Crill, PhD, Senior Client Solutions Director and Vice President Do Elections Matter to the Stock Market? View All Insights

Oct 09, 2026 Topic Asset Allocation Economic Perspectives Equity Investing

In Episode 60 of The Informed Investor podcast: We interrogate common myths about the impact of elections on markets and offer sensible answers as investors head to the polls. KEY TAKEAWAYS The data doesn’t show any strong connection between election results and stock market performance. Investors may overemphasize the impact of elections in their home market while ignoring politics in other countries.  VIEW ALL EPISODES ON YOUTUBE
